title: DelegationToken
description: A scoped, time-limited authorization token issued by a passport holder to a sub-agent. The scope can never exceed the grantor's own capabilities (scope reduction rule).

tokenId.description: Unique delegation token identifier. Format: del_{randomHex(16)}

agentId.description: Agent ID of the grantor — the passport holder issuing this delegation

granteeId.description: Agent ID of the grantee — the sub-agent receiving delegated authority

scope.description: The authorized scope for this delegation. Always a subset of the grantor's capabilities.

capabilities.description: Capabilities delegated to the grantee. Must be a subset of grantor's capabilities.

systems.description: List of allowed system URLs or patterns. Use '*' for all systems. Supports glob-style prefix matching (e.g. '*.example.com').

maxActions.description: Maximum number of actions the grantee can perform before this token is exhausted. Omit for unlimited.

allowedHours.description: Optional time window restriction. Array of UTC hours (0–23) during which this token is valid.

usageCount.description: Number of times this token has been consumed via consumeDelegation()

active.description: Whether this token is currently active. Set to false when revoked or single-use token is consumed.

singleUse.description: If true, this token is automatically deactivated after first use.

issuedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this token was issued

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this token expires

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex signature over canonical JSON payload (all fields except signature, keys sorted alphabetically)

scopeReductionRule.description: Delegation cannot grant capabilities the grantor does not hold. If grantorCapabilities is provided to issueDelegation(), requested capabilities are automatically filtered to the intersection.

grantorCapabilities.description: The full set of capabilities held by the grantor. Used to enforce scope reduction.

requestedCapabilities.description: The capabilities the caller wants to delegate.

grantedCapabilities.description: The actual capabilities granted: intersection of requested and grantor capabilities.
